hypotheses.justification: Apply heatPotential_kernel_integrable_on_split with center z := q, retaining radius r and all other assumptions. Its ball-membership hypothesis follows from Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le. By heatPotential_near_far_cover, its integration domain is univ, as is the original split domain centered at z. Transport the resulting integrability facts between these equal domains to obtain hInt, then leave the remaining proof unchanged. This works for every q, including points outside the original ball; hr still excludes zero and negative radii.
